Digitalization of society takes an increasingly significant role in our lives.
For example, take a look at measuring the speed of cars, running a red light and the distance somebody walked. These statistics are all measured digitally and automatically.
In the construction world, labor-intensive activities are also being automated. However, there are still a few exceptions, such as measuring the ground settlement.
These measurements are still mainly done by hand, which is very labor-intensive. There are a few digital solutions, but these are too expensive.
We offer a cheaper, clearer and easier solution to this problem.
We are the future of ground settlement measurements, we are Soilspect!

Bygkontrol offers professional consulting services for construction projects of all sizes, including:
• Design
• Planing
• Project Managment
• Engineering Consultancy

We can handle your entire building project and coordinate the work of all actors to meet your wishes and demands – as well as your economy timeframe.We are your reliable partner in all types of construction.
• Structural calculations
• Energy calculations
• Design of technical installations
• Etc.
 
ICT, BIM and VDC
ICT stands for Information and Communication Technology. Within construction, ICT is the common denominator for all the digital tools and methods that are used to systemize and control the design and construction processes throughout all phases of a construction project.BIM stands for Building Information Modeling.BIM is the concept of modelling buildings in 3D and adding information to the individualbuilding parts which can be used throughout the entire lifecycle of the building.VDC stands for Virtual Design and Construction.
 
Digitalization consultancy in the construction industry
Digital tools and methods keep gaining greater ground in the construction industry. Every part of the industry can benefit from exploiting the digital opportunities to a greater extent. However, the possibilities are endless, and it can be very difficult to gain the complete overview.For many, it is a complex process to implement new digital tools and work methods while concurrently running a business.Therefore, it may be worthwhile to collaborate with a digitalization consultant who specializes in construction.Bygkontrol can help you map your specific needs and possibilities within digitalization and guide you through the implementation and use of the tools and methods that will make a difference to your construction company. 
 
VDC is a way of analyzing and simulating a construction workflow before the construction phase. It helps optimize the construction process and minimize mistakes.Bygkontrol can handle or assist all your ICT, BIM and VDC work including 3D laserscanning and softwaredevelopment.

description: DemandSide Instruments (DSI) is developing a unique end-to-end solution for farmers to better manage resource usage in agricultural fields. The solution is comprised of connected sensors deployed in plots, allowing farmers to procure a detailed and accurate analysis of the crops at any given moment. The farmer can track the sensors performance and manage them remotely through DSI’s mobile app- AliaTerra. The solution is currently deployed in an operational environment, and has over 100 active clients in Reunion Island and Normandie. The company offers an array of connected sensors, measuring various soil, air, and water parameters in cultivated plots. The data collected indicates the parcel’s irrigation, pesticides and fertilization needs, thus helping farmers manage their resources better. To connect the data from different sensors and process it, we utilize Edge computing technology- Each sensor functions as a node in the network, and information is transferred securely from the sensors in the field to a gateway bridge using LoRaWAN technology. The solar-powered bridge performs independent data analysis, and interacts with DSI’s cloud service (Dandelion) for further data processing. Analysis is done by Decision Support Tools (DSTs) integrating related data from different sensors to present a comprehensive analysis of the field. The DSTs are Machine Learning algorithms developed by DSI, learning data on different irrigation needs (depending on climate, type of crop, field size, etc.) and generate recommendations for the farmers on preferred irrigation schedules. The farmer (i.e., the end-user) interacts with the data, the sensors and the recommendations made by the DSTs via the company’s management application (AliaTerra). The app allows farmers to remote control irrigation, thus simplifying the work flow in the field. Moreover, the system reports any anomaly concerning the crops, which enables the farmer to get ahead of losses linked to frost, drought, leaks, etc. By utilizing DSI’s solution, water consumption and pesticide application can be significantly reduced while yield increases.

Delivering socially and environmentally positive, appropriate innovation and building partnerships for success are my passions. I work with non-profits, international organizations and social businesses to best use available tools and technologies or develop new approaches where necessary, and aim for outcomes that make sense. Holistic approaches are key to me, as I learn from and innovate for people: through applying user/needs centered approaches I get to know their pain points, co-create with them and make sure that solutions – technical or otherwise – are a benefit to everyone. 
I am an information & software engineer, experienced project manager, event facilitator, community manager and strategic technologist with over 14 years’ experience and a background in both, information systems management and engineering, including space based projects. I led several projects, ranging from software development to data and knowledge systems implementation to research projects at the intersection of information systems and several societal challenges like renewable energy, crisis management, waste reduction or international development. I have successfully run various online and offline events for audiences from all walks of life in English, German and Spanish and coordinated the Climate Knowledge Brokers group, a community of practice and have repeatedly spoken in public about the topics I am passionate about.

entityDescription:
The University of Basel has an international reputation of outstanding achievements in research and teaching. Founded in 1460, the University of Basel is the oldest university in Switzerland and has a history of success going back over 550 years.
As a comprehensive university offering a wide range of high-quality educational opportunities, the University of Basel attracts students from Switzerland and the entire world, offering them outstanding studying conditions as they work towards their bachelor’s, master’s or PhD degrees. Today, the University of Basel has around 13,000 students from over a hundred nations, including 2,900 PhD students.
The University of Basel has seven faculties covering a wide spectrum of academic disciplines. At the same time, the university has positioned itself amidst the international competition in the form of five strategic focal areas: Life Sciences, Visual Studies, Nanosciences, Sustainability and Energy Research and European and Global Studies. In international rankings, the University of Basel is regularly placed among the 100 top universities in the world thanks to its research achievements.
The University of Basel has deep roots in the economically powerful and culturally rich Basel region. The university also works closely with domestic and international partners to make relevant contributions to the advancement of the sciences and society. This also means that the University of Basel pays particular attention to aspects of sustainability, equal opportunity and knowledge transfer.

DamoTech seeks also to develop a variety of services, including an analysis on cyber risks deriving from the human factor, and the assessment of a company’s cyber maturity level, with regards to new technologies, and internal and external processes.
Since its birth, DamoTech has been deep inside the cyber security field, possessing a high-level of multidisciplinary skills. In this context, a specific R&D project emerges: our Cyber Threat Intelligence platform, aims to collect, handle and process unclassified information, through the emission of high quality, semiautomatic reports guarantees by analysts and AI/ML components. The platform is entirely dedicated to the Space environment and Space's assets (OT and IoT).
DamoTech’s scientific methodology comes from its team based on a group of managers and experts which is combines University background as ethical landscape (PhD is the target), that incorporates a multidisciplinary approach in developing technologies and products perfectly aligned with the customers' needs.

Furthermore, the company has as its object the training in the cyber security field, both technical and non-technical, with the aim of spreading the culture of information security and the acquisition of digital skills both in the public and private sectors, at a professional and non-professional level.

Indeed, within DamoTech we have established two Laboratory:
1) The Center for Cyber Security and International Relations Studies (CCSIRS) established in 2015, aims at promoting and deepening the knowledge on cyberspace's dynamics through a policy and technology oriented approach. More specifically, activities are focused on analyzing the influence that cyberspace exercises over both national security and the international system's stability, peace and security.
2) The X-Lab, established on April 2021 combines tests and effective simulations and emulations on Space assets. At the same time, the Lab seeks to investigate, study and test disruptive technologies at the edge of innovation landscape. The aim of the X-Lab is to analyze impacts and opportunities with an empirical approach.

entityName: Ústav makromolekulární chemie AV ČR, v. v. i. The Institute of Macromolecular Chemistry, Czech Academy of Sciences (IMC)
entityDescription:
The Institute of Macromolecular Chemistry, Czech Academy of Sciences (IMC), is an internationally recognised research and educational organisation in the field of synthetic polymers. Its mission is advancing the area of macromolecular chemistry, organic chemistry, macromolecular physical chemistry and macromolecular physics including their related interdisciplinary fields with the purpose of acquiring knowledge about relations between structure, properties and function of macromolecular systems and about controlled creation of supramolecular structures.
Our research is oriented on the development of new synthetic and technological processes, on new polymer materials and their applications as well as on design of polymers for electronics, for medicinal chemistry and for tissue engineering including investigation of interactions of biological systems with polymeric materials. The combination of interdisciplinary teams of knowledgeable experts with up-to-date experimental facilities is the main asset of the Institute. Although the Institute is primarily focused on fundamental research, it also closely cooperates with the application sphere. This is particularly true for application of polymers in medicine, but also for material research and for assessment of the ecological impact of plastic waste. The Institute provides training in polymer science for postgraduate, graduate as well as undergraduate students enrolled at Czech universities. It also traditionally runs internationalpostgraduate courses in polymer scienceunder the auspices of UNESCO and IUPAC.
